THE FAUNA AND FLORA PROTECTION ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 469)
Order under Subsection (2) of Section 2

BY virtue of the powers vested in me by Subsection (2) of Section 2 of the Fauna and Flora Protection Ordinance (Chapter469), I, John Amarathunga, Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife and Christian Religious Affairs, do by this Orderdeclare the area of land described in the Schedule hereto to be a Sanctuary for the purposes of the aforesaid Ordinanceand further declare that such Sanctuary shall be called and known as the “Kayankerni Marine Sanctuary”.
JOHN AMARATHUNGA,Minister of Tourism Development, Wildlife
and Christian Religious Affairs.
Colombo,11th April, 2019.
SCHEDULE
LIMITS OF THE AREA OF LAND COMPRISING THE KAYANKERNI MARINE SANCTUARY

All that area of land comprising in extent 953 hectares situated within the Korale Pattu - North DivisionalSecretary’s Division in the Baticoloa District, Eastern Province and the maritime zone adjacent to that area of land and
